leadText:
Double Team (Japanese: ダブルチーム Double Team) is a pair of Pokémon Trainers that debuted in the Generation IV and reappear in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl. They are depicted as a pair of male and female s.

They use of opposite genders and fight in Double Battles.

The first Double Team appears on , but most are found in with powerful and well-trained Pokémon. Compared to other Double Battle teams, their AI is very skilled.

They are the Generation IV version of 's and Generation VI and 's .
